description: Semantic search across a project's version-pinned documentation — the fastest way to pull just the passage you need for an exact version instead of reading the whole llms.txt. Returns chunks ranked by relevance, capped by `token_budget`. Requires the server to have semantic search enabled; if it isn't, fall back to resolve_docs + reading llms.txt.

snapshot.description: Immutable revision_id returned by resolve_docs; omit to use the current capture.

token_budget.description: Max tokens to budget for results (default 4096)

name: search_docs
